replay_comparison: exact decoded text, termination, and scoring; token equality reported separately
evaluation_budget_scope: per checkpoint: legacy evaluation plus all primary/replay launch wall time; interrupted launches reserve their entire allowance
preparation_budget_scope: At most 3600 seconds per checkpoint for pinned downloads and hashing.
memory_enforcement: systemd cgroup MemoryMax at max_rss_bytes, MemorySwapMax=0; recorded peak RSS must also pass because shared pages can be charged elsewhere
timeout_enforcement: systemd RuntimeMaxSec and TimeoutStopSec=0; min(task limit, remaining checkpoint budget)
legacy_evidence: Closed diagnostic comparator and cost record only; no legacy answer is reused as a new reply.
stop_rule: Baseline must pass the frozen per-category and total gate before any modular download. Replay every primary answer, including errors. Stop on execution failure, source/artifact mismatch, replay disagreement or budget. No retry, training, alternative model or automatic promotion.
worker_environment: Research-only CPU native instruction selection and eight threads, set before torch import; exact replay on the same host. No change to ledger numerical rules.
replay_policy: All 24 replies per checkpoint, generated independently in fresh workers.
method_change: Fresh 24-case reference; native CPU kernels on a temporary Sapphire Rapids host, eight threads, 128-token cap, 600-second call limit and 112 GiB worker cap. Strict native tool validation contributes to scoring. Published weights and expert activation remain unchanged.
success_interpretation: reference_ready measures completed baseline and modular comparison with replay. growth_screen_passed additionally requires preservation, gains and latency; neither grants admission or A2 credit.
